statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, r is the maximum, over all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), of |nums[(i+1) mod len(nums)] - nums[i]|. Here |x| is the absolute value of the integer x, and (i+1) mod len(nums) uses the usual nonnegative remainder.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, the function max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r for some 64-bit integer r; it does not fail.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, we have 0 <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, we have r <= 200.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that r = |nums[(i+1) mod len(nums)] - nums[i]|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), we have |nums[(i+1) mod len(nums)] - nums[i]| <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, r = 0 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[0].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, r = nums[len(nums)-1] - nums[0].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r, r = nums[0] - nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1, nums[i] >= nums[i+1].

statement: For every integer k with 0 <= k < len(nums), let rot be the slice of length len(nums) defined by rot[i] = nums[(i+k) mod len(nums)] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r and max_adjacent_distance(rot) returns Result.ok r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let rev be the slice of length len(nums) defined by rev[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r and max_adjacent_distance(rev) returns Result.ok r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every integer c satisfying -100 <= nums[i] + c <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), let shift be the slice of length len(nums) with shift[i] = nums[i] + c. Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r and max_adjacent_distance(shift) returns Result.ok r', we have r = r'.

statement: For every integer k with k >= 0 and with -100 <= k * nums[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), let scaled be the slice of length len(nums) with scaled[i] = k * nums[i]. Whenever max_adjacent_distance(nums) returns Result.ok r and max_adjacent_distance(scaled) returns Result.ok r', we have r' = k * r.
